dct_title_s: Jones County, Iowa, 1936, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol FU form of individual image numbering: FU-2-[number], FU-4-[number], FU-5-[number], FU-6-[number], FU-7-[number], FU-8-[number], or FU-12-[number]. Date of publication inferred from dates on individual photographs within the mosaic. Flown by Wallace Aerial Surveys, Spokane, Wash."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
